Gideon Sato, here's a draft from what's in #inc-vtg-hartford (times are company time, as shown in the channel):

*Hartford gate check-in incident – summary for Procurement*
• *First report:* Aug 3, 10:42 AM. Both inbound gate kiosk lanes at Vantorre's Hartford plant showed a white screen after badge scan. Check-in was done manually on a clipboard in the meantime.
• *Kiosk 1 restored:* Aug 3, 11:03 AM. Mateo confirmed the guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch could see it.
• *Both lanes confirmed working:* Aug 3, 11:07 AM (posted 11:08 AM).
• *Scope:* This affected gate check-in only. Scheduling stayed available from the dispatch office. The separate status-page access issue is tracked under INC-4821 and was still open at last update. The channel is being kept open for another arrival cycle.

I've left out the cause. The channel only says Carrowmere Cloud was checking the Hartford gateway route, with no confirmed root cause. If you want one in, please give me the wording. This is a draft only. I haven't emailed it to anyone. Mateo is outside pemberline.com, so sending it to him would need Ruth Calloway's approval.
